lessons.trigger_condition: V386 can learn from matching verified outcomes across Tablet GPT and TCG Grader, but its selected action does not yet combine verified sample support, ensemble disagreement, operational KPI, drift and regime transitions into an explicit uncertainty bound; feature proposals also need an explicit verified shadow-canary-active_candidate-rollback lifecycle.
lessons.prevention_rule: V387 must keep V386 as the upstream hard gate, compute bounded action confidence from verified sample support, peer/local/neural agreement, KPI and operational drift, hold non-recovery mutation when confidence is low or the operational regime is unstable, allow only recovery-class actions during unstable regimes, and keep source-level feature proposals non-executable until protected PR/CI, regression, integrity, alignment and actual-output validation succeed.
